name: press under
description: An Olympic style drill where you press yourself down under a barbell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and speed.
instructions: Start standing with a light barbell at the front of your shoulders and a grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Brace your trunk and press the bar upward as you actively lower your body underneath it.
Receive the bar overhead with locked arms in a stable squat stance.
Stand up while keeping the bar overhead, then lower it to the front rack to reset.
